sections.label: Countries ratifying Paris Agreement
sections.summary: 134 countries accounting for over 80% of world greenhouse gas emissions have ratified the Agreement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: To date, 134 countries accounting for over 80% of the world's total greenhouse gas emissions have ratified the Agreement.

sections.label: Singapore emissions pledge and industry
sections.summary: Singapore pledged to improve emissions intensity by 36% from 2005 levels by 2030 and peak around then, with industry the largest energy user.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, we are committed to do our part to protect the environment and have pledged to improve our emissions intensity by 36% from 2005 levels in 2030, and to peak around the same time under the Paris Agreement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In Singapore, the industry sector is the largest energy user, consuming about two-thirds of our total energy consumption and contributing about 60% of our carbon emissions in 2014.

sections.label: Improvement rates needed for pledge
sections.summary: Meeting the climate pledge requires doubling or tripling current improvement rates to 1% to 2% annually, similar to Belgium and the Netherlands.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: This upward trend is in the right direction.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: However, in order to meet our climate pledge, we need to double or triple the current improvement rates and achieve 1% to 2% annually, similar to that attained by leading jurisdictions, such as Belgium and the Netherlands.

sections.label: Design reviews for industrial facilities
sections.summary: From 2018, new industrial facilities and major expansion projects must undergo design reviews to incorporate energy efficiency measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: With this in mind, from 2018, we will require new industrial facilities and major expansion projects to undergo design reviews to incorporate EE measures.

sections.label: MEPS extended to industrial motors
sections.summary: MEPS will be revised and extended to industrial equipment and systems, starting with motors in 2018, expected to abate 0.4 megatonnes by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MEPS currently covers household appliances and has been successful in raising the EE of these household products.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will revise and extend MEPS to industrial equipment and systems, starting with motors in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We expect MEPS for motors to translate to some 0.4 megatonnes in carbon abatement by 2030.

sections.label: VES replacing CEVS
sections.summary: VES will replace the current CEVS, as announced during the recent Committee of Supply debate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: As I have announced during the recent Committee of Supply (COS) debate, VES will replace the current CEVS.

sections.label: Industrial energy efficiency improvement
sections.summary: The sector must improve energy efficiency, with Singapore pledging a 36% emissions intensity cut by 2030 under the Paris Agreement.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It is thus important that this sector improves its EE.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We pledged a 36% emissions intensity improvement by 2030 under the Paris Agreement.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In January this year, Environment and Water Resources Minister Masagos Zulkifli had shared that Singapore-based companies achieved an annual EE improvement rate of 0.6% in 2015, and 0.4% in 2014.

sections.label: Minimum energy performance standards
sections.summary: Because NEA data shows many industrial equipment are inefficient, companies deploying new facilities must now meet newly introduced MEPS.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Data from NEA shows that a large number of industrial equipment are inefficient.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Hence, companies, when deploying new facilities, will now have to ensure that they meet the newly introduced MEPS.

sections.label: Redesigned Energy Efficiency Fund
sections.summary: The EE Fund will be redesigned to help companies identify and undertake EE retrofitting, co-funding up to 30% of investments in efficient technologies.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am pleased to note that the EE Fund will be redesigned to better support companies to identify and undertake EE retrofitting.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This Fund will co-fund up to 30% of investments in more efficient technologies.

sections.label: Energy storage investment incentives
sections.summary: More can be done to attract investors in energy storage, and the Energy Storage System Testbed under the Energy Storage Programme launched a Request-for-Proposal last year.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: More can be done to attract investors through incentives and a certain climate to encourage them to invest in energy storage applications and technology.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I understand that under our Energy Storage Programme, the Energy Storage System Testbed is one of the initiatives to explore energy storage feasibility and technology in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This is a fairly new initiative, and the Request-for-Proposal was launched last year.

sections.label: Germany study on Paris Agreement
sections.summary: A German study found slowing climate change could boost the world economy by $19 trillion, with renewable and EE investments adding about 0.8% to global GDP by 2050.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Germany recently commissioned a study to analyse the potential impacts of the Paris Agreement, and the report revealed that efforts to slow climate change could boost the world's economy by $19 trillion.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Investments in renewable power and EE will add about 0.8% to global gross domestic product by 2050.

sections.label: Vehicle emissions scheme shift
sections.summary: The Bill replaces CEVS with a VES covering other pollutants besides carbon dioxide, and the speaker suggests future incentives for reducing actual emissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Bill moves us from CEVS to a VES that takes other harmful pollutant emissions into consideration, in addition to carbon dioxide.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: It is good that it will be a requirement to label the vehicular emissions instead of just the fuel economy of vehicles, given that we are not meeting our 2020 target for PM10, PM2.5 and ozone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: However, under both CEVS and the new VES, rebates and surcharges are not given based on actual carbon or pollutant emissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Hence, the system incentives purchase of more energy-efficient vehicles, which is a good thing, but it does not incentive less mileage and, hence, less actual emission.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: I suggest that in future, we consider shifting towards an incentive system that incentivises the reduction of actual emissions, in addition to the purchase of less pollutive vehicles.

sections.label: Qualifying third party consultants
sections.summary: Efforts with industry bodies should ensure consultants producing these assessments are suitably qualified.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Since this new legal requirement may trigger a growth in third party consultants producing such assessments, efforts should be undertaken in concert with industry bodies to ensure that consultants offering their services in this field to generate these reports are suitably qualified.

sections.label: Singapore Climate Action Plan target
sections.summary: Singapore's July 2016 Climate Action Plan intended manufacturing to achieve energy efficiency improvement rates of 1% to 2% yearly from 2020 to 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Singapore's Climate Action Plan released in July 2016 revealed our intention to encourage the manufacturing sector to achieve EE improvement rates of 1% to 2% a year between 2020 and 2030.

sections.label: Energy efficiency incentive schemes
sections.summary: The Government is planning reviews of incentive schemes, including an EE financing pilot and investment allowance, alongside previously implemented schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: I believe the Government has spotted these barriers and is planning to conduct reviews of incentive schemes to support companies in this transition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: This includes piloting an EE financing programme and providing investment allowance for EE.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: I understand as well that we have implemented previous energy-related incentives and grant schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: This includes the Design for Efficiency (DfE) Scheme, Energy Efficiency Improvement Assistance Scheme (EASe), Grant for Energy-Efficient Technologies (GREET), and the Singapore Certified Energy Manager (SCEM) Training Grant.

sections.label: E2F grants timing question
sections.summary: The question asks whether MEWR or NEA will make the E2F available given the Bill's enhanced requirements start in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Given that the Bill's enhanced requirements will come into effect from 2018 onwards, will MEWR or NEA make available the E2F so that companies affected will have time to apply for the grants?

sections.label: China renewable power investment
sections.summary: China will invest 2.5 trillion yuan, about S$506 billion, into renewable power generation by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As mentioned in my speech, China is making big moves in renewables.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: They will be investing 2.5 trillion yuan, about S$506 billion, into renewable power generation by 2020 as they set their eye on becoming a green energy superpower.

sections.label: MEPS motors savings estimate
sections.summary: MEPS for motors is expected to save 1,100 GWh annually by 2035, and the Bill's enhancements to contribute at least 7% of greenhouse gas emissions reductions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: With the introduction of MEPS for motors, we expect to achieve annual savings of 1,100 GWh (gigawatt hours) or around 2% of Singapore's electricity consumption by 2035, as companies replace their less efficient motors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Collectively, the enhancements in this Bill are expected to contribute to at least 7% of our greenhouse gas emissions reductions.

sections.label: SolarNova rooftop solar installation
sections.summary: Under SolarNova, solar systems will be installed on rooftops of about 6,000 Government buildings by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Under the SolarNova programme, solar systems will be pervasively installed on the rooftops of about 6,000 Government buildings, such as public housing, schools, army camps and utilities, by 2020.

sections.label: NEA consolidates EE grants
sections.summary: NEA decided to review and consolidate existing EE grants into the E2F due to low take-up rates and company feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: NEA decided to review and consolidate the existing EE grants into the E2F, given the low take-up rates noted by Mr Louis Ng and in response to feedback from companies on the need to improve the financial support and accessibility to the grants.

sections.label: E2F support for SMEs
sections.summary: E2F will emphasise SMEs and give 50% support to eligible companies to co-fund design reviews and energy audits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: E2F will place greater emphasis on SMEs and there will be 50% support given to eligible companies to co-fund design reviews and energy audits.

sections.label: Investment Allowance Scheme for EE
sections.summary: The Investment Allowance Scheme for EE allows up to an additional 30% investment allowance against taxable income on eligible capital expenditure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The Investment Allowance Scheme for EE is a tax incentive that allows up to an additional 30% investment allowance against taxable income on capital expenditure related to eligible projects by companies.

sections.label: Annual intake for programmes
sections.summary: The annual intake for these programmes is about 350 students.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The annual intake for these programmes is about 350 students.
